Was Eve deceived? Yes, but still we don't know what she knew before that occurred. There is language that the two trees were in the midst of the garden. That is, they had high profiles. Both were there to be seen. We are also told in the Book of Mormon, that if they had eaten right away from the Tree of Life, they would have lived forever in their sins. (See Alma 12:21-23) So they had to be cut off right away, and put out of the garden. They would now die the temporal death, and the spiritual death. Before they were put out, they were clothed. Remember that the Garden of Eden is the first temple of the earth. They have instruction from God, they are clothed, and they are told what to do, and then they had to leave. There is another veil pulled over at that time, and they enter into a world totally different from the one they left. We should empathize with them a little more. Living in a Paradise beyond our comprehension, we think about moving to that one eventually, and have hope that it will be better. They had been there, and lost light in leaving. They went the opposite direction. They knew what they lost. It was very painful. We voluntarily agreed to come here, and we knew the conditions of the plan. We agreed to come through Adam.

Ever since the supernatural guardians were placed at the gateway to Eden, the entrances to holy places in many ancient cultures have been guarded by some form of cherubim (already a plural, without adding s). The meaning of the word cherub (singular) is not precisely known, but the ancient statues representing cherubim were usually composite creatures with parts from the bull, lion, eagle, and so on to symbolize superior powers (BD and TG, "Cherubim").
